hook.name: PMUReactorHook
hook.description: Fee hook for an ETH/PMU pool that applies a time-decaying launch fee on ETH-in (zeroForOne exact-input) swaps. The fee starts at a configurable high rate and decays block-by-block to a 2% base fee, with proceeds split between a buy-and-exile receiver and a team address. Exact-output swaps are blocked. Sell swaps (PMU→ETH) incur a flat 2% fee collected in afterSwap.
